description: Use this only when another Matchaa tool needs a guestToken and none exists yet in this conversation; create_tailored_resume opens a guest space itself, so do not call this before it. Opens a private guest space, without an account. Reuse the returned guestToken for every later Matchaa call in the conversation, including edits, and keep it private. A limited number of complete adaptations is free in a guest space; edits, previews and downloads do not use them. Do not open another guest space to get around that limit.
name: create_guest_context
title: Open a Matchaa guest space
